title: Do New Attention Mechanisms Actually Fix Attention Sinks at Million-Token Context?
abstract: arXiv:2609.08574v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long context language models now advertise windows of one million tokens, but two habits limit how much of that window is used. Attention heads with nothing useful to read still spend their budget on the first token, which is called the attention sink, and where a fact sits in the context changes whether the model finds it. Gated attention cut first token attention from 46.7 percent to 4.8 percent at NeurIPS 2025, and Kimi K3 pairs that idea with Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals behind a one million token window, eight times past the range where these diagnostics have been reported. This paper asks whether the fix survives that jump. We build SinkProbe, a suite that measures sink mass, massive activation, position resolved recall and the recency gap, and apply it to four small models that differ only in how they mix tokens and depth. Three results follow. The training objective produces the sink, not the architecture. Gatin

translated_title: 新的注意力机制真的能在百万词元上下文中修复注意力汇聚问题吗？
translated_abstract: 长上下文语言模型如今宣称拥有百万词元的窗口，但两个习惯限制了该窗口的实际利用程度：没有有用内容可读取的注意力头仍会将其预算花费在第一个词元上，这被称为注意力汇聚，而事实在上下文中所处的位置会影响模型能否找到它。门控注意力在 NeurIPS 2025 上将首词元注意力占比从 46.7% 降至 4.8%，而 Kimi K3 将这一思想与 Kimi Delta Attention 和注意力残差结合，置于百万词元窗口之后，这已是此类诊断方法此前被报告范围的大约八倍。本文旨在探究这种修复方案能否经受住这一跨越。我们构建了 SinkProbe，这是一套用于测量汇聚质量、大规模激活、位置分辨召回率以及近因差距的评估工具，并将其应用于四个仅在词元混合方式与深度上有所差异的小型模型。由此得出三个结果：是训练目标而非模型架构产生了注意力汇聚，门控注意力机制的效果在很大程度上取决于……
tldr: 该论文提出 SinkProbe 诊断套件，在四个小型模型上测量注意力汇聚等现象，发现注意力汇聚主要由训练目标而非模型架构决定，并检验门控注意力等新机制在百万词元上下文中是否真正有效。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SinkProbe, a diagnostic suite measuring sink mass, massive activation, position-resolved recall and the recency gap across four small models, finding that the training objective rather than the architecture produces attention sinks and testing whether gated attention truly fixes them at million-token contexts.
